summary: Sculptor Diversified Real Estate Income Trust filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing its August 31, 2026 net asset value per share. NAV per share ranged from $11.6694 for Class E and operating partnership units to $10.9170 for Class I-S, with total NAV of approximately $685.1 million across 60,201,465 shares and units. Components included $794.4 million of real estate, $180.9 million of real estate debt and $371.9 million of net financing obligations. The filing is a periodic NAV update for the non-traded REIT, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation or advisor were disclosed.
